tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// ma hā mā yā'i cho ga sgyu ma chen po snang ba zhes bya ba dang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bklag chog tu bkod pa bcas bzhugs so//

༄༅// phyag rgya che dang rjes chags pa'i// sgyu 'phrul chen mo he ru kar// phyag byas de yi sgrub pa'i thabs// ku ku ri pa'i lugs bzhin dgod// dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la rnal 'byor gyi yo byad tshang bar bstar nas/ 'di ltar bsgom par bya ste/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐/ de'i 'od zer gyis mahā mā yā'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs shing*/ 'od zer de nyid las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyi nyer spyod dang*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍā ki nī oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab sgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ ces bdun rnam dag bya/ tshogs zhing rang nyid la thim/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzña na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkhar nyi ma la hūm̐/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'og thams cad sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i mda'i drwa ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol me kha dog lngas yongs su bskor ba'i nang du chos 'byung sngon po/ de'i nang du rlung me chu dang sa'i dkyil 'khor ri rab dang bcas pa de dag zhu ba las dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i nang sna tshogs pad+ma phyogs sngo ser dmar ljang mtshams dkar ba rdo rje'i 'phreng ba sngon pos spras pa'i lte ba dang phyogs la nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng thig le dkar po re re las 'od zer 'phros/

don gnyis byas tshur 'dus pa las/ phyogs kyi thig le byams sogs tshad med bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi lha mor gyur pa rnams kyis/ kye ma gnyen mchog rdo rje 'od kyis pad+ma kha phye zhig a la la la hoḥ bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor pad+ma kha rab 'byed pa zhig /bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /ces pa'i glus bskul nas lha mo dag slar thig ler thim/ 'gro ba thams cad 'khor ba las bsgral bar bzhed pa sgyu ma lta bu'i gzigs pas thig le hūm̐ du gyur cing de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma hā mā ya sku mdog sngon po sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis na ka pā la dang mda'/ g.yon pa gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gis rang 'dra ba'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la 'khyud pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing thal chen gyis byugs pa/ thod skam gyi cod pan dang mgo rlon gyi do shal/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi'i pags pa bgos te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar can 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa nam mkha' dang chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin/ shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi/ g.yas pa gnyis na rdo rje dang ka pā li/ g.yon pa gnyis na dril bu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ sa dang me long lta bu'i rang bzhin can/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo ser sngo dkar ljang ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang tri shū la/ g.yon pa gnyis na ba dan dang ce spyang gi mgrin pa dam du 'dzin pa/ chu dang mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin can/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro dkar mo dkar ser ljang ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na sna tshogs pad+ma dang mda'/

g.yon pa gnyis na ka pā la dang gzhu/ me dang so sor rtog pa'i rang bzhin can/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ljang mo ljang ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon pa gnyis na zhags pa dang ka pā la/ rlung dang bya ba grub pa'i rang bzhin can/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang mtshan dang dpe byad du ldan pa'i gcer mo thod skam gyi dbu rgyan thod rlon gyi do shal phyag rgya lngas spras te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ mig gnyis su a/ rna ba gnyis su khe/ sna gnyis su tsi/ snying gar ra/ thugs ka'i cha stod du nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus bsgoms pa 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dzaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin/ puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wi d+yā= shap+ta= oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍāki nī oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod bdud rtsi 'bul/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i 'od kyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lag pas lo ma bus pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu dang bkra shis kyi glus mngon par dbang bskur/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ lha mo rnams la rim pa bzhin rtag pa dang*/ rin chen/ 'od dpag med/ don grub rnams kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa sna tshogs kyis lag pa brel ba'i lha mo dpag tu med pa snying ga nas spros te de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par mos te/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar sngar bzhin dang*/ oṃ ā badz+ra rū pa pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shap+ta= gan+dhe= rā sa= spar+she= spro na/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra wir+ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de bzhin du/

waṃ she= mu rañdze= smṛ taṃ ge= hā s+ye= lā s+ye= gīrti= nīrti= pūṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= rū pa= rā s+ye= spar+she= dhārma dhā tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces rig ma bcu drug gis kyang mchod/ de nas bstod pa bya ste/ mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs pa che// sngags kyi me tog 'phreng bas brgyan// sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa// he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal// de nas/ rjes su chags pa brtsam pa'i phyir lha mo rnams kyis/ kye/ grogs po mchog gis bdag cag gi /pad+mo kha ni rnam dbye bar// 'od gsal ba ni rdo rje yis// bde ba nyid mdzod a la la ho// gtso bo yab yum gyi mgo bor oṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar swā/ gsang gnas su āḥ brla gnyis su hā rnams rigs lnga'i rang bzhin/ yum gyi mkha' hrīḥdamar po las pad+ma dmar po/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i ge sar ser po/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ sngon po las rdo rje sngon po/ oṃ las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po/ lha mo rnams la gzigs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ lhan cig rdo rje dang pad+ma bskyod cing phaṭ gyi sgras sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad bkug zhal nas zhugs/ rjes chags kyis zhu ba rdo rje nas lha mo'i pad+mar lhung ba'i byang chub kyi sems lces myang bar bsam/ de nas/ bdag gi snying gar 'byung ba bzhi'i rang bzhin pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi'i dbus su me rlung gi ngo bo dang*/ sa chu'i bdag nyid kyi nyi ma dang zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi thig le sran ma phyed gshags tsam kha sbyar ba/ nang du thig le dkar po tsa na ka tsam nyi zla la ma reg pa/ 'od kyi skud pa ba thag lta bu las brgyus pa'i ā li bcu drug kā li so bzhi'i 'phreng ba nyi zla thig le gang la yang ma reg pa thig le la g.yas skor du tshar phyed dang bdun sbrul 'khril ba ltar bskor bar bsam ste/ phyir 'byung ba na 'phreng ba'i mgo'i a las tog ces pa'i sgra byung bas steng gi zla ba phug ste/

bu ga nas yar rlung gi ngo bo'i sngags 'phreng oṃ gyi rang bzhin gyi sna sgo g.yas nas phar song*/ nang du 'jug pa hūm̐ gi sgras sna sgo g.yon nas byung ste zla ba'i bu ga la zhugs/ gnas pa a'i rang bzhin gyi thig le la g.yon skor du lan phyed dang bdun bskor ba dmigs te tsam nus su bzla'o// ngal na sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ gtso bo'i sngags so// oṃ bud+dhā ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ de nas/ dngos po dang dngos po med pa mnyam par mthong bas sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dod pa lnga longs spyod pa'i mchod pa tsam ste/ gang zhig bdag gis byas bsod kyis/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro bsgom gyur cing*// de yis rdo rje mkha' 'gro bdag /'gro don phun tshogs thob gyur cig/ ces dge ba bsngos/ khams gsum po thams cad he ru kar shes pas rjes spyod la 'jug go /bdud rtsi dang kha zas gtor ma/ hūm̐ de las mi bskyod pa 'thon te des phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi rnams phyag tu blangs de nyid la thim pas sbyangs/ a las 'og tu rlung dang me'i 'khor lo'i steng du ka pā la/ de'i nang du 'od dpag med byon nas bdud rtsi blangs/ de dag la thim/ kha dog dri ro bcud dri ma med pa'i phun sum tshogs par sbar ro// oṃ las rnam snang gis bdud rtsi blangs/ de dag la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lce rtse rdo rje sbu gu can des drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu h+ya bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes pas myang*/ khrus la 'jug tshe dbang bskur bzhin no// ༈ da ni dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas phyi'i dkyil 'khor du bri ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal la dri dang bdud rtsis bran te/

lha grangs kyi tshom bu byas/ mchod pas mtha' bskor te/ de la/ bsang sbyangs/ mdun gyi tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las sgyu 'phrul chen mo lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma phyogs sngo ser dmar ljang mtshams dkar ba rdo rje'i 'phreng ba sngon pos spras pa'i lte ba dang phyogs la nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng thig le dkar po re re las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus/ yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das mā hā mā ya sogs lha bskyed/ dgug gzhug dbang bskur/ mchod rig ma bcu drug bzhag na 'thus bstod kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la dgongs// khyed rnams mchod pa'i phyir dang ni// slob ma rnams la phan pa'i phyir// sgyu ma chen mo zhes bya ba'i// dkyil 'khor bzang po bri bar 'tshal// bdag la byin gyis brlab par mdzod// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dkyil 'khor gyi las byos shig ces gnang ba byin nas/ ye shes pa dbyings su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par bsam/ de nas lag pa mnyam bzhag las g.yas sa la lan gsum brdebs pas/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin po che'i bum pa 'dzin pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa lte ba yan chad sa gseb nas 'thon pas ci bgyi zhes brjod pa gnas par gyur/ de la/ pri thi wī de wī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ= buṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wi d+yā= shap+ta= oṃ a kā ro lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa shākya seṅge yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri//

zhes pa'i bar lan gsum brjod pas/ lha mo de dga' ba'i mdangs kyis/ khyod ni slob dpon yin pas na// dkyil 'khor mchog gi las gyis shig /ces gnang ba byin nas sa de nyid du thim par gyur/ de nas/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig gi 'od zer gyis bre brag gi sa'i bdag po 'khor bcas a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas bkug bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin/ sa phyogs gnas pa'i lha dang klu// gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin// gang dag rdzu 'phrul che ldan pa// rdo rje'i spyan dang snyan mnga' ba// bdag ming che ge mo rdo rje 'dzin zhes pa// bde gshegs rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir// dge ba'i sa phyogs 'di nyid du// dkyil 'khor dam pa cher 'byung ba// sgyu ma chen mo rgyud rgyal gyi// dkyil 'khor chen po'i las byed pas// khyod kyis bar chad ma byed par// dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ ci dga' bar gyis shig ces dga' bas gnang ba byin te/ badz+ra muḥrang gnas su gshegs/ tshom bu dang mchod rdzas bsdu/ phyogs de nyid du zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ lho 'phye brtag ro lnga bsal/ sa la bdud rtsi lnga dang dri chu hūm̐ bzlas pas 'khor ba'i sas dgang 'thas par bcag khar dri dang ba byung gi rnam lngas byug me tog gsil ma bkram/ sum+bha ni lan bdun gyis sbyangs/ de nas slob dpon rgyan drug sogs pas brgyan te/ rdo rje dril bu dang ldan pas/ hūm̐ khaṃ zhes pas/ sa gzhi nam mkhar song*/ hūm̐ laṃ/ zhes pas/ slar rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me di nī badz+rī bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūm̐/ sa gzhi rnam par dag pa de bzhin nyid du mos/ de nas der/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐ sogs tshogs bsags nas bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas/ slob dpon stegs kyi khar 'dug slob ma rnams phyogs su bkod/

gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ gtor ma hūm̐ de las mi bskyod pa 'thon te des phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi rnams phyag tu blangs de nyid la thim pas sbyangs/ a las 'og tu rlung dang me'i 'khor lo'i steng du ka pā la/ de'i nang du 'od dpag med byon nas bdud rtsi blangs/ de dag la thim/ kha dog dri ro bcud dri ma med pa'i phun sum tshogs par sbar ro// oṃ las rnam snang gis bdud rtsi blangs/ de dag la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa la sogs pa sarba k+ṣe tra pā la i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ma ma sa pa ri wā rā na sarba satwā nāñtsa/ sarba pā paṃ byā dhi bigh+na shīn+taṃ ku ru dha na ka s+ya ā yuḥ.a rokya puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ sarba bha yaṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis btang*/ slar yang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi// nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// 'bru nor tshe dang 'khor rgyas shing*// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod//

ces 'dod don gsol te rol mo bya zhing*/ gtor ma gtsang sar dor ro// de nas slob ma rnams kyis mchod bstod bya ste/ spros pa rgyas par na/ slob dpon gyis phyogs bzhir mchod pa bshams/ slob ma rnams phyogs so sor 'khod nas/ thun mong du byin gyis brlabs/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i skur gyur/ zhes sogs phyogs so so'i mkha' 'gro mar bskyed nas phyi nang gsang mchod tshogs zhing skabs ltar phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// sogs de nyid lnga bstod phyogs so sor phral nas sh+lo ka res bstod/ shar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// lho nas mchod cing bstod la/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spang*// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// nub nas mchod cing bstod la/ zhi ba'i mchog ni chos las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnams sbyong ba// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// byang nas mchod cing bstod la/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur// dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// ces gsol ba gdab/ bsdu na thun mong nas mchod pa dang*/ rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis sprul pa sna tshogs ston mdzad pa'i// gdug pa 'dul phyir 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa// khro bo'i rgyal po he ru ka dpal 'dud// ces dang*/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ni// sdig pa ma lus zad byed pa// sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor ni// mgon po chen pos bshad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pa gsan nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis snying rje chen po bskyed de/

rten brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor snying gar thim par gyur ces bsdus nas/ bdag nyid he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis mig ma dang ṭa las nyi zla/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las rdo rje mthing nag rkang mthil gnyis su a las sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba/ mig 'bras kyi rdo rje las khro bo 'phros pas bgegs kyi tshogs 'joms par byed pa rkang 'gros kyis rdo rje'i rwa ba sogs sprul par bsgoms la/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol bas dbang ldan du song ste/ nyon cig bgegs tshogs ma lus kun// lha dang lha min gsang ba pa// gnod par 'gyur ba'i bgegs tshogs rnams// sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rnal 'byor gtso// bde chen ye shes las byung ba// de ni he ru ka dpal dngos// bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor byed// gal te bka' las 'das gyur na// rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// 'jig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// de bas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// zhes bka' bsgos te/ bdag rdo rje 'dzin pas slob ma dang sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang la 'god par bya ba'i don du/ bcom ldan 'das sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi las rtsom par byed kyi/ 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang srin po la sogs pa gang dag gnas pa'i sa bdag rnams dengs shig 'di ltar dpal he ru ka'i bka' thos nas myur ba nyid du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la ngas rdo rje dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dis mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o// na ma ཿsan+ta bud+dhe bh+yo/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ ma hā daṃ ṣ+ṭot+ka ra bhai ra wā ya/ badz+ra san+to ha dar+pā ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces lan gsum brjod cing yung dkar gyis brabs/ gu gul gyis bdug ting nge 'dzin gyis bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ g.yas skor lan gsum bya/ rkang pa'i 'og nas bskal pa'i me lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros pas gdug pa can thams cad bsregs shing phan tshun du byer bar

bsam la gom brgyad la sogs pa'i gar bya'o// seng ldeng gi phur pa chur sor bcu gnyis sboms su sor bzhi pa tsan dan dmar pos kha bsgyur ba/ mgor me tog yungs kar kha dog sna lnga'i skud pa dkris pa bsangs/ sum+bha ni sogs/ thugs ka nas byung ba'i gnod mdzes la bka' bsgos pas de las sprul pa'i gnod mdzes gnyis pa 'ongs te des bgegs dang log 'dren rnams lcags kyus bkug zhags pas bcings/ lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ dril bus mnyes/ phyogs bcur gan rgyal du bsgyel ba'i khar/ khro bo bcu stod khro bo smad rtse mo gcig pa'i rdo rje phur bu'i rnam par snang ba oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ dbyings nas ye shes kyi khro bo bcu spyan drangs nas dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bstim/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor gnas pa la/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭān bigh+nāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ra ādzñā pa ya ti/ sarba duṣ+ṭān kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ga ra badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya/ zhes gnod mdzes kyi rdo rje lcags kyu de rdo rje tho ba me rab tu 'bar bar gyur pas/ phur bu rnams bsdigs pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas gsang ba'i bar du phug ste sa gzhi la sbrags nas g.yo 'gul med cing bde ba chen po'i ror gyur/ de rnams las ye shes kyi me kha dog rnam pa lnga rab tu 'bar bas gdug pa can thams cad bsregs par gyur/ dngos su las kyi rdo rjes phyogs bcur gdab/ de nas/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa nyid/ raṃ las nyi ma/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi ra ba dang drwa bar bcas pa'i rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol me kha dog lngas yongs su bskor bar bsam mo// bgegs bsal ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas der lha gnas su dri'i thig le me tog gi tshom bu bkod/

mtha' mchod pas bskor/ de bsangs nas/ mdun gyi tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las/ nam mkhar nyi ma la hūm̐/ de yongs su gyur pa las sogs nas/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma hā mā ya sku mdog sngon po sogs rten gzhal yas khang*/ brten pa lha bskyed pa/ go bskon/ gnas gsum byin brlab/ dgug gzhug dbang bskur/ rgyas btab/ don grub rnams kyis dbu brgyan par gyur bar/ de nas mchod pa sna tshogs kyis lag brel ba'i sogs/ nyer spyod/ 'dod yon lnga/ rig ma bcu drug dang bcas pa'i sngags kyis mchod/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che// zhes sh+lo ka dang*/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ sogs de nyid lngas bstod/ de nas/ rjes su chags pa brtsam pa'i sogs nas/ byang chub kyi sems lces myang bar bsam bar gyis bdud rtsi myang*/ de nas btud de/ he ru ka dpal gsol ba ni// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang ldan// phyogs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma bdag cag la ni phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pas// nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa'i bar gyis lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slar dri chu sogs/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ lha lhag gnas so// ༈ de nas bum pa mtshan ldan mtshan ma ras dkar gyis mgul dkris shing bzang po'i lo mas kha brgyan pa/ rnam rgyal sogs rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang*/ las bum la sna tshogs rdo rje'i bum mtshan gdags /nyer lnga dang chu gtsang mas bkang*/ spos kyis bdug sum+bha ni sogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha grangs sam med na las thams cad pa dang gnyis gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas bstod/

mchod pas bskor la/ bum pa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtso bo'i bum pa'i nang du pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma/ de'i steng du thig le dkar po re re/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma hā mā ya sku mdog sngon po sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis na ka pā la dang mda'/ g.yon pa gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gis rang 'dra ba'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la 'khyud pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing thal chen gyis byugs pa/ thod skam gyi cod pan dang mgo rlon gyi do shal/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi'i pags pa bgos te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar can 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa nam mkha' dang chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin/ shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi/ g.yas pa gnyis na rdo rje dang ka pā li/ g.yon pa gnyis na dril bu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ sa dang me long lta bu'i rang bzhin can/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo ser sngo dkar ljang ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang tri shū la/ g.yon pa gnyis na ba dan dang ce spyang gi mgrin pa dam du 'dzin pa/ chu dang mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin can/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro dkar mo dkar ser ljang ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na sna tshogs pad+ma dang mda'/ g.yon pa gnyis na ka pā la dang gzhu/ me dang so sor rtog pa'i rang bzhin can/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ljang mo ljang ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon pa gnyis na zhags pa dang ka pā la/ rlung dang bya ba grub pa'i rang bzhin can/

thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang mtshan dang dpe byad du ldan pa'i gcer mo thod skam gyi dbu rgyan thod rlon gyi do shal phyag rgya lngas spras te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ bum pa lha grangs yod na dbus su gtso bo yab yum/ bum pa gzhan rnams su 'khor rnams/ rnam rgyal chen por thams cad yud tsam gyis gsal btab/ las thams cad pa'i bum par hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang khu bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon brkyang gis nyi ma la khro bo'i chas kyis brgyan te bzhugs pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ mig gnyis su a/ rna ba gnyis su khe/ sna gnyis su tsi/ snying gar ra/ thugs ka'i cha stod du nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus bsgoms pa 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dzaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin/ puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wi d+yā= shap+ta= oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍā ki nī oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod bdud rtsi 'bul/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i 'od kyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lag pas lo ma bus pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu dang bkra shis kyi glus mngon par dbang bskur/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ lha mo rnams la rim pa bzhin rtag pa dang*/ rin chen/ 'od dpag med/ don grub rnams kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa sna tshogs kyis lag pa brel ba'i lha mo dpag tu med pa snying ga nas spros te de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par mos te/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar sngar bzhin dang*/ oṃ ā badz+ra rū pa pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/

de bzhin du/ shap+ta= gan+dhe= rā sa= spar+she= spro na/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra wir+ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de bzhin du/ waṃ she= /mu rañdze= smṛ taṃ ge= hā s+ye= lā s+ye= gīrti= nīrti= pūṣ+pe= dhū pe= a lo ke= rū pa= ra s+ye= spar+she= dhārma dhā tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces rig ma bcu drug gis kyang mchod/ de nas bstod pa bya ste/ mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs pa che// sngags kyi me tog 'phreng bas brgyan// sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa// he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal// mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ las kyi lhar/ rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyi sprul sku sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// gdug pa 'dul phyir 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can// khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil ba khyod la 'dud// ces bstod/ de nas/ sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas lha rnams kyi sku rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pas bum pa gang bar bsam la rnam par rgyal pa'i bum pa la gtso bo/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ bum pa gzhan rnams la 'khor/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/

oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ las thams cad pa la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bzlas/ lha rnams chags pa chen pos byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam/ bum pa lhag gnas so// ༈ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis slob ma rnams bsdus zhal du zhugs te rjes chags kyis zhu ba rdo rje nas lha mo'i pad+mar lhung ba he ru ka sgyu ma chen mor gyur nas phyir 'thon so so'i gdan la 'khod pa'i mos pa gyis/ de nas/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir gang bzhugs pa// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de// skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig/

zhes spro ba bskyed/ de nas/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi// tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// sgyu 'phrul gtso bo yab yum dang*// mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa dang*// chos mchog la yang skyabs su mchi// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis// byang chub sems mchog bskyed pa ltar// de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do// 'gro ba'i mgon po bdag la dgongs// ma lus gshegs pa'i bde gshegs rnams// 'di nyid nas gzung sangs rgyas bar// bla med bdag la gzigs par mdzod// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// nas/ mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// gnyis su med pa'i tshangs spyod dang*// rang gi dam tshig bsrung bar bgyi// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams kyis// sangs rgyas myur du 'grub byas te// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// bla med gnas su bsgral bar bgyi// de nas slob ma'i snying mgrin dpral bar/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ mas rim gyis rdo rjes reg cing dris thig le bya/ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan par mos la slar yas rim gyis bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ gnas gsum gyi sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te yi ge gsum la thim pas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du byin gyis brlabs par gyur

pa la mchod yon dang rnam lnga rol mos mchod/ so shing tshad ldan tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i maṇ+ḍal du rtsa ba so la drud de/ badz+ra hā sa ha/ zhes pas dor/ rtse mo gar bstan la dngos grub 'grub par brda sprad/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha dhārma sarba pā paṃ ni tsā s+ya bi sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐/ ces pas khyor chu byin/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// u dum+bā ra'i me tog ltar// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'di ni// de bas kyang ni rnyed dka' ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// bla na med pa byed par nus// gnyis med zab mo'i tshul 'di ni// sems can sangs rgyas thob byed pa// dang po bskal pa grangs med nas// bsags pa'i sdig pa gang dang gang*// de kun zad par 'gyur ba ni// zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so// yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i ku sha sngas dang stan du byin/ snying po bzlas shing mdud pa gsum pa'i srung skud dpung pa g.yon par bcings/ de nas ku sha'i sngas stan la seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyol la rmi lam rtogs shig nang par bzhin bzang rnams longs shig /sang gi nang par khyed rnams kyis// thar pa chen po'i rang bzhin gyi// grong khyer dam pa mthong bar 'gyur// zhes brjod/ mtshan ma ngan na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis rtog pa bsal/ rjes kyi bya ba 'jig rten 'das ma 'das la gtor ma 'bul/ mchod pa gso/ snying ga nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍāki ni oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi 'bul/ mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs pa che// sogs dang*/ de nyid lnga bstod bya/ yig brgya bzla zhing nongs bshags bya/ yid kyis dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg

tshom bu bsdu'o// de nas thig kha dog lngar dbye ba thod pa'i snod du bzhag bsang sbyangs/ thig skud mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon gyi phyag rgya can/ dkar po bh+rūm̐ las rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ ser po dz+riṃ las rin 'byung ser po mnyam bzhag mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ dmar po aṃ las snang mtha' dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ ljang khu khaṃ las don grub ljang khu mnyam bzhag dang skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya can du gsal ba la ye shes pa mig gi rdzi ma bteg pa 'bar ba'i blta bas badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ sa dgug dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bstim/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mor bcas pas mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ de nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i thig gdab phyir// rdo rje'i thig ni bdag la stsol/ rigs lnga 'od du zhu ba thig skud du gyur zhes thig skud du bsgyur ba/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥpa ra sa pa ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭha sarba dharmāḥ.a d+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces bsgril/ bdud rtsi lnga la sbangs/ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod lte bar rdo rje khu tshur gyis/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes shar nub nas brtsams te rtsa thig nam mkha' dang 'og tu gdab/ de nas tshon thig bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// sems can khams rnams bsgral bya'i phyir// rnam par snang mdzad rgyal po che// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// sogs rigs lnga kar 'gres shing*/ dbang ldan nas brtsams te bri/ der bum pa la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams thogs te lan gsum de la bskor te hūm̐ zhes sgra sgrog cing rdor dril 'dzin/

slob dpon de'i nang du zhugs par mos pas dbus su mnyam par bzhag te/ oṃ ut+ga ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pas yid kyis sgo bzhi dbye/ rnam rgyal dbus/ rnam rgyal chen po de'i khar/ gzhan phyogs bzhir/ las thams cad sgo g.yon du'o// gnas brgyan/ de nas dkyil 'khor bsangs/ rten brten par bcas pa bskyed/ se gol gyi sgras sta gon gyi ye shes pa de la bkug slar ye shes pa de la gzhug pa nas bstod pa'i bar zhes dkyus su 'di tsam las gsal bar mi 'byung yang*/ rje btsun gu ṇā'i zhabs kyis slob dpon ku ku ri pa'i rim pa gsal ba dang*/ rngog lugs kyi yig rnying sogs kyi dgongs don ltar gsal bar mdzad pa bzhin bya ba ste/ dkyil 'khor gang du bya ba'i gnas khang legs par brgyan cing rab gnas dang ldan pa'i bris sku sogs bkrams/ rdul tshon nam ras bris gang la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi mthar srung ba'i yan lag tu phyogs mtshams brgyad na/ mda'/ ral gri/ me long rnams brgyad re zug cing*/ tshon skud gyi dra bas sbrel/ bum pa lnga yod na phyogs bzhi dbus lnga dang*/ gnyis las med na rnam bum shar dang*/ las bum byang shar du bzhag dbu rgyan lho/ rdo rje nub/ dril bu byang*/ ming dbang rdor dril shar/ 'o ma dang bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i gsang thod lho/ rig tsaka nub/ mig thur/ me long*/ mda' gzhu/ 'khor lo dung dang glegs bam rnams bris 'bur gang rigs g.yas skor du bkod/ rnam lnga sogs mchod pa'i bye brag brgya phrag gam lha grangs las mi nyung bas bskor/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang*/ 'jig rten 'das ma 'das kyi gtor ma/ chos skyong dud sol ma'i gtor ma rnams bshams/ maṇ+ḍal chas/ slob mchod/ mig dar me tog me tog dor ra bcas dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du mchod pa rnam lnga/ rdor dril/ cang te'u/ nang mchod/ nas bzed/ yungs snod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad tshogs par byas la/

rang nyid skad cig bcom ldan 'das sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i skur gyur/ hūm̐ brjod pas bgegs bsal la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa lan gsum gyis srung ba bya/ bdud rtsi'i steng du hūm̐/ de las mi bskyod pa 'thon te des phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi rnams phyag tu blangs de nyid la thim pas sbyangs/ a las 'og tu rlung dang me'i 'khor lo'i steng du ka pā la/ de'i nang du 'od dpag med byon nas bdud rtsi blangs/ de dag la thim/ kha dog dri ro bcud dri ma med pa'i phun sum tshogs par sbar ro// oṃ las rnam snang gis bdud rtsi blangs/ de dag la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'bru gsum mang du brjod cing*/ rdo rje'i rtses dkyil 'khor dang yo byad rnams la bsang gtor byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ lha mtshan rnams skad cig gis 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de'i rkyen gyis rten gzhal yas khang brten pa lha dang bcas pa thabs shes rab kyi rang bzhin skad cig gis gsal bar gyur pa ni nam mkhar nyi ma la hūm̐/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'og thams cad sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i mda'i drwa ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol me kha dog lngas yongs su bskor ba'i nang du chos 'byung sngon po/ de'i nang du rlung me chu dang sa'i dkyil 'khor ri rab dang bcas pa de dag zhu ba las dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i nang sna tshogs pad+ma phyogs sngo ser dmar ljang mtshams dkar ba rdo rje'i 'phreng ba sngon pos spras pa'i lte ba dang phyogs la nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du lha yi mtshan ma rnams bdud rtsi'i thig le'i rnam par gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma hā mā ya sku mdog sngon po sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can/

phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis na ka pā la dang mda'/ g.yon pa gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gis rang 'dra ba'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la 'khyud pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing thal chen gyis byugs pa/ thod skam gyi cod pan dang mgo rlon gyi do shal/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi'i pags pa bgos te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar can 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa nam mkha' dang chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin/ shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi/ g.yas pa gnyis na rdo rje dang ka pā li/ g.yon pa gnyis na dril bu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ sa dang me long lta bu'i rang bzhin can/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo ser sngo dkar ljang ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang tri shū la/ g.yon pa gnyis na ba dan dang ce spyang gi mgrin pa dam du 'dzin pa/ chu dang mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin can/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro dkar mo dkar ser ljang ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na sna tshogs pad+ma dang mda'/ g.yon pa gnyis na ka pā la dang gzhu/ me dang so sor rtog pa'i rang bzhin can/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ljang mo ljang ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon pa gnyis na zhags pa dang ka pā la/ rlung dang bya ba grub pa'i rang bzhin can/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang mtshan dang dpe byad du ldan pa'i gcer mo thod skam gyi dbu rgyan thod rlon gyi do shal phyag rgya lngas spras te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi lha rnams badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ sogs/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/sgrub mchod sogs la sta gon gyi lha bstim pa nyin dang po ma gtogs mi dgos/ oṃ badz+ra pra we sha ya hūm̐/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin par gyur/ oṃ ut+ga ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas lan bzhis sgo dbye/ de nas rang gi snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐ sogs tshogs zhing nas brtsam te bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan bdun gyis/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis su med par thim/ gzhung las skabs 'dir bum pa 'god par bshad do/ /gtso bo yab yum gyi se gol gyi sgra dang*/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ bdag gi zhal du zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i pad+mar spros/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yum gyi mkha' yi nang nas phyir byung*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs pa che// sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan// sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa// he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal// ces bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i 'od kyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lag pas lo ma bus pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu dang bkra shis kyi glus mngon par dbang bskur/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ lha mo rnams la rim pa bzhin rtag pa dang*/ rin chen/ 'od dpag med/ don grub rnams kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa sna tshogs kyis lag pa brel ba'i lha mo dpag tu med pa snying ga nas spros te de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par

mos te/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pāñtsa ḍāki ni ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes mchod yon 'bul ba sngon du 'gro bas/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa// gzugs mdzes dkar mo rdo rje dril bu dang*// me tog spungs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ dkyil 'khor kun tu= yid 'ong dud kha rdo rje dril bu dang*// bdug spos 'thul ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ nam mkha' gang ba= dhū pe= dkyil 'khor kun tu= kun snang dmar ser rdo rje dril bu dang*// mar mes gang ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang bas= ā lo ke= dkyil 'khor kun tu= gdung sel ljang khu rdo rje dril bu dang*// dri mchog byug pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang bas= gan+dhe= dkyil 'khor kun tu= zhal zas ser mo rdo rje dril bu dang*// bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang bas= nai wi d+yā= dkyil 'khor kun tu= sgra snyan sna tshogs rdo rje dril bu dang*// pi waṃ gling bu rnga chen sogs 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang bas= shap+ta= 'dod yon lnga 'bul ba ni/

rin chen dbang gi rgyal po baiḍūr+ya'i// sngon po la sogs kha dog dbyibs kyi gzugs// rnam gsum gzugs kyi rdo rje mar byas nas// dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍā ki nī rū pa pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ ma zin 'byung ba'i tshogs pa las byung ba'i// brjod bral dbyangs la sogs pa'i sgra yi tshogs// rnam gsum sgra yi rdo rje mar byas nas// dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la dbul bar bgyi// shap+ta= ga pur a gar dzā ti la sogs pa// legs par sbyar las byung ba dri yi tshogs// rnam gsum dri yi= dkyil 'khor lha yi shangs la= gan+dhe= lus mchog brtas byed bdud rtsi'i zas sogs kyi// mngar skyur kha dang bska la sogs pa'i ro// rnam gsum ro yi= dkyil 'khor lha yi ljags la= rā sa= lus la reg pa tsam gyis bde ster ba'i// dpag bsam gos la sogs pa reg bya'i tshogs// rnam gsum reg bya'i= dkyil 'khor lha yi sku la= spar+she= rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa ni/ rab mdzes lta bas mi ngoms lang tsho can// dga' ba'i nyams bzhis sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs// pi wang gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga ma// rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bas mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra wīrni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ waṃ she= mu rañdze= smṛ taṃ ge= rab mdzes lta bas mi ngoms lang tsho can// mchog dga'i nyams bzhis sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs// bzhad dang dregs ldan glu dbyangs gar mkhan ma// rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bas mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra hā s+ye= lā s+ye= gīrti= nīrti= rab mdzes lta bas mi ngoms lang tsho can// khyad dga'i nyams bzhis sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs// me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri chab ma// rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bas mchod bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra pūṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= rab mdzes lta bas mi ngoms lang tsho can// lhan skyes dga' bzhis sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs// gzugs bcud reg bya chos dbyings rdo rje ma// rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bas mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra rū pa=

rā s+ye= spar+she= dhārma dhā tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni/ bdud rtsi'i steng du hūm̐/ de las mi bskyod pa 'thon te des phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi rnams phyag tu blangs de nyid la thim pas sbyangs/ a las 'og tu rlung dang me'i 'khor lo'i steng du ka pā la/ de'i nang du 'od dpag med byon nas bdud rtsi blangs/ de dag la thim/ kha dog dri ro bcud dri ma med pa'i phun sum tshogs par sbar ro// oṃ las rnam snang gis bdud rtsi blangs/ de dag la thim pas bdud rtsi rgya mtsho zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ ljags rdo rje sbu gu can des drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu h+ya bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa haṃ/ gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ gtso bo yab yum gyi mgo bor oṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar swā/ gsang gnas su āḥ brla gnyis su hā rnams rigs lnga'i rang bzhin/ yum gyi mkha' hrīḥdamar po las pad+ma dmar po/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i ge sar ser po/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ sngon po las rdo rje sngon po/ oṃ las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po/ lha mo rnams la gzigs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ lhan cig rdo rje dang pad+ma bskyod cing phaṭ gyi sgras sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad bkug zhal nas zhugs/ a wa dhū tī'i lam nas byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor gyur pa sku'i cha thams cad du khyab pas bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi dga' ba nyams su myong bar gyur/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ gang gis rnam rtog rnam spangs te// byang chub sems ni rnam bsgom zhing*// lus dang sems ni rnam dag la// 'di ni don dam mchod pa yin// de nas bstod pa ni/ mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs pa che// sngags kyi me tog 'phreng bas brgyan// sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa// he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal// gzhan yang*/ thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can// thugs rjes skur sprul 'gro don mdzad// sku gsung thugs kyi dbang phyug gtso// he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhal bzhi phyag bzhi spyan gsum mdzes// zhabs gnyis phyed krung gar tshul gyis// pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs// rgyal ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku mdog sngon po cher 'bar ba'i// 'jigs byed mche ba gtsigs pa po// g.yas ser g.yon ljang rgyab zhal dkar// gnyis med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bdag

/rigs btsun rig mas mgul nas 'khyud// dbu la rigs kyi bdag po bzhugs// bde chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sgeg cing dpa' byad 'jigs su rung*// drag dang rgod dang 'jigs par byed// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi// nyams dgu'i yon tan khyod la 'dud// nam mkha' 'od kyis khebs mdzad cing*// 'jigs pa po yang 'jigs par mdzad// phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan// bde gshegs sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yas g.yon dang po mda' dang gzhu// lhag ma thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin// mgo phreng brgya phyed do shal byas// mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dbu skra khams pa gyen du sgrengs// ka pā la lngas dbu la brgyan// na ra'i stod g.yogs stag lpags bsnams// 'jigs rung khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// dngos po'i rang bzhin kun gyi mchog /sku la mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs// 'gro ba'i don ni mdzad pa po// sku gsum bdag nyid khyod la 'dud// khyod kyi ye shes spyan zur gyis// mi mthun phyogs rnams skrag mdzad cing*// rgyal mtshan dril bus slar gso mdzad// thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sku gsum ye shes lnga bdag nyid// bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi gtso// 'gro ba mi shes gcod pa po// stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang*// de nyid brtan pa g.yo bcas pa// khams gsum 'di dag thams cad kyi// bdag nyid chen po khyod la 'dud// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel byed cing*// phun sum tshogs pa kun ster ba// byang chub lam ni ston pa po// ye shes sku khyod phyag 'tshal bstod// bsam med dpe dang bral bas brjod du med// bde chen sku ste mi 'gyur 'dus ma byas// dngos dang dngos med rnam spangs dmigs pa med// bde chen sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// shar phyogs lha mo rdo rje'i rigs// byams pa'i bdag nyid sku mdog sngo// sa khams me long ye shes bdag

/rdo rje mkha' 'gror= lho phyogs lha mo rin chen rigs// snying rje'i bdag nyid sku mdog ser// chu khams mnyam nyid ye shes bdag /rin chen mkha' 'gror= nub phyogs lha mo pad+ma'i rigs// dga' ba'i bdag nyid sku mdog dkar// me khams so sor rtog rang bzhin// pad+ma mkha' 'gror= byang phyogs lha mo las kyi rigs// btang snyoms rang bzhin sku mdog ljang*// rlung khams bya ba grub rang bzhin// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror= thams cad zhal bzhi phyag bzhi ma// phyag na rang rang mtshan ma 'dzin// mtshan dang dpe byad sku la rdzogs// rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal bstod// sku la 'od kyi phreng ba 'phro// mi mgo khrag 'dzag do shal byas// zhabs gnyis nyi mar phyed krung bzhugs// 'khor gyi lha mor= phyag rgya rnam pa lnga dang ldan// ka pā la lngas dbu la brgyan// sgeg pa la sogs nyams dang ldan// lha mo'i 'khor la phyag 'tshal bstod// rje btsun 'khor dang bcas pa la// bdag gis bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis// sems can kun gyis rje btsun gyi// go 'phang bla med thob par shog/ ces bstod/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ skabs 'dir yi ge gsum dang 'brel ba'i sngags bzla bar gsungs pas/ gtso bo'i oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ yum sogs kyis/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥswā hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhāḥhūm̐/ ces pa rnams so sor bzla'o// de nas bum bskyed bzlas pa 'od zhu'i bar sta gon skabs ltar bya/ de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa ni/ bde mchog ltar bya zhing*/ brtag gnyis las 'byung ba'i kau la e reṣ+ṭa sogs rdo rje'i glu yang blang bar bya'o// de nas rdo rje slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor ba bya zhing shar phyogs su zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ gtor ma'i steng du hūm̐/ de las mi bskyod pa 'thon te des phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi rnams phyag tu blangs de nyid la thim pas sbyangs/

a las 'og tu rlung dang me'i 'khor lo'i steng du ka pā la/ de'i nang du 'od dpag med byon nas bdud rtsi blangs/ de dag la thim/ kha dog dri ro bcud dri ma med pa'i phun sum tshogs par sbar ro// oṃ las rnam snang gis bdud rtsi blangs/ de dag la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo phyogs skyong zhing skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mchod pa'i gnas 'dir byon par gyur/ ces spyan drangs la/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje phra mo'i dbyibs can 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bud+dhā ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ oṃ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ hrīḥphaṭ/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ āḥphaṭ/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ hoḥphaṭ/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ ha ha hoḥphaṭ/ ces lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// sogs de nyid lngas bstod/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// bzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// ces brjod cing rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i don bsam/ oṃ ā hūm̐ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa la sogs pa sarba k+ṣe tra pā la i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/

ma ma sa pa ri wā rā na sarba satwā nāñtsa/ sarba pā paṃ byā dhi bigh+na shīn+taṃ ku ru dha na ka s+ya ā yuḥ.a rokya puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ sarba bha yaṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'jig rten pa rnams la gtor ma phul/ he ru ka dpal yab yum ni// rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas// zhing skyong brgyad dang phyogs skyong brgyad// dur khrod gnas pa'i ma mo'i tshogs// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// zhes sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥgator mgron rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ de nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las rang nyid he ru ka dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnam pas logs su bye bar mos la bdag nyid 'jug par bya ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon mgon la skyabs su mchi// gtso bo mkha' 'gro mar bcas pa'i// lha rnams kun la phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcing*/ slob dpon gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma bdag nyid rab tu gzhug par bgyi// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la dang bas/ oṃ na maste hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes phyag 'tshal/ shar sgo nas snying gar thal mo sbyar/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pū dzo pas+thā nā ya āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes phyag 'tshal/ mi bskyod pa snying gar thim/ de bzhin dpral bar thal sbyar/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pū dzo pas+thā nā ya āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na saṃ bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swā māṃ/ rin chen 'byung gnas dpral bar thim/

mgrin par thal sbyar/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pū dzo pas+thā nā ya āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma dhā ra a bhi ṣiñtsa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swā māṃ/ snang ba mtha' yas mgrin par thim/ spyi bor thal sbyar/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pū dzo pas+thā nā ya āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta a mo gha a bhi ṣiñtsa sid+dhi tiṣ+ṭha swā māṃ/ don yod grub pa spyi bor thim/ zhes phyag byas/ las thams cad pa'i chus bkru/ shar sgo'i phyir 'khod pa na slob dpon la me tog dang bcas pa'i phyag byas te/ dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// bdag la sdom pa rnams kyang stsol// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa// slob dpon chen po bdag la gson// zhes so// de nas slob dpon gyis/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong*// sdom pa brtan por 'gyur ba'o// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya// byang chub sems gang deng rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so// slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar bya// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad// rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni// nyin re bzhin yang lan drug tu// chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba 'o// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// zhes pa'i bar gyis phog slob mas/ sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo// he ru ka dpal mkha' 'gror bcas// kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// slob dpon spyan sngar de ring nas// bzung ste ji srid byang chub kyi// snying po la ni mchis kyi bar// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson// gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de ltar bdag ni bgyi bar 'tshal// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsam te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spong ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba// pad+ma'i rigs mchog chen po la// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyang gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems kyang bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god//

de nas/ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes me tog gi 'phreng ba dang bcas pas rnal 'byor du sems bskyed/ rdo rje snying gar bkod/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bo dhi tsit+ta badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ de nas/ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐ zhes pas nang du bcug deng khyod he ru ka dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod dpal sgyu ma chen po'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpal he ru ka dang mkha' 'gro ma'i dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du brjod par mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag khyod kyis su yang rung ba la// gal te khyod kyis smras gyur na// khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje yis// rang gi mgo bo 'gas par 'gyur// bdud rtsi lnga'i chu snying po bzlas te/ he ru ka dpal nga yin gyis// nga yis bsgo ba khyod gyis shig /khyod kyis nga la brnyas byas na// mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas// dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re// de nas slob mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// bdag la byin gyis rlobs mdzod la// rdo rje ye shes dbab tu gsol// slob dpon chas su zhugs shing 'gying bas slob ma la bltas te/ rdzas kyis bdug oṃ badz+ra ā be sha zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing rol mo bsgrag thugs ka'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug ste de la gzhug des ma babs na/ slob ma'i snying gar zla ba la he ru ka yum bcas snyoms par zhugs pas 'od zer dmar pos lus thams cad gang ba la dmigs te sngags bzlas so// babs nas lce la a dmar po bsam nas/ smros shig 'dod chags chos chen po// dpag tu med pa bde ba che// dge dang mi dge 'dri 'dri bas// babs nas dge dang mi dge ston/ de nas yi ge brgya pas brtan par byas/

de nas/ 'di ni bsod nams ji lta bar// rigs kyi rim bzhin 'di yi lha// 'di yis dngos grub gang 'grub dang*// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog/ slob mas/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas dor/ de nas slob ma'i lag pa bzung ste/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hri sa mig phye/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub dang*// dngos grub kun khyod mngon du gyur// dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// gsang sngags la yang brtson par bgyi// dkyil 'khor chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa dang*/ me tog phog pa'i lha 'di'o zhes bstan/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal dang yon phul te/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal// de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas yungs kar lag pa g.yas g.yon du bzung la so sor lag gnyis g.yas g.yon du bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya/ badz+ra satwa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha da ha swā hā/ bzlas shing yungs kar me la dor ro// de bzhin du g.yas su bskor ba yang bya zhing*/ yang chu dang kham phor dang dur bā dang bcas ba'i ba lci'i chang bu dang*/ zan changs kyis kyang bskor zhing mer mi 'dor/ de nas lag pas nye reg byas la snying gar dri/ mgor me tog mdun du yon chab/ mar mes bskor zhing mar dang spos dkar gyis bdugs shing phyir dor ro// de ni bgegs sdig pa mi shis pa sbyang ba'o// de nas/

phyogs lhor pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du seng ge'i khrir dar sna tshogs kyis 'bol ba'i gdan la slob ma bkod/ steng du gdugs dkar po bzung*/ slob ma skad cig gis dpal he ru ka bcom ldan 'das ma hā mā ya sku mdog sngon po sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis na ka pā la dang mda'/ g.yon pa gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gis rang 'dra ba'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la 'khyud pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing thal chen gyis byugs pa/ thod skam gyi cod pan dang mgo rlon gyi do shal/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi'i pags pa bgos te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar can 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa la sngar me tog dor ba'i rigs kyi lhas me tog gi phreng bas dbang bskur bar gyur/ oṃ dharma kun+da a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ zhes spyi bor bcings par bsam/ de nas slob dpon gyis bum pa thams cad kyis rtsa ba'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor la g.yon nas bskor ba lan gsum byas nas/ de dag gi chu bsdus la/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa gyis byas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ cod pan bsangs/ cod pan mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las rin chen 'byung gnas ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum sgrol ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang 'khril ba dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa gsal ba la bsgoms pa dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

rin 'byung 'od du zhu ba rin po che'i cod pan du gyur/ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rin po che'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa phul/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas rin po che'i cod pan gyi dbang bskur bar mos/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ oṃ badz+ra pa taṃ ka badz+ra ā ra li hoḥ rdo rje rtse dgu pa bsangs/ dbang rdzas kyi rdo rje mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las 'od dpag med pa pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang 'khril bar dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa gsal ba la bsgoms pa dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'od dpag med 'od du zhu ba rdo rjer gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rdo rjes dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo sogs/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// de ring khyod la dbang bskur bya// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// shin tu grub phyir rdo rje gzung*// oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ lag g.yas su gtad/ snyems pa'i tshul gyis lag g.yas su 'dzin du bcug thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag/ ces brjod/ de nas dril bu bsangs/ dbang rdzas kyi dril bu mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri thod 'dzin pa dang 'khril ba dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa gsal ba la/

bsgom pa dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ don grub 'od du zhu ba dril bur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dril bu'i dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo sogs/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// g.yon du gtad/ dril bu dkrol du bcug srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol du bcug pa la phyag rgya chen po dang ldan pa la/ rdo rje dril bu yang dag 'khyud// g.yon snyems pa dang sgrol don 'chang*// gnyis med gnyis med rnal 'byor te// phyag rgya chen po byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ oṃ shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta kye dpal/ me tog phog pa'i rigs kyi ming btags/ de nas rdo rje lag par gtad la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs// he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan// zhes rdo rje'i brtul zhugs byin/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// bdag gis bla med byang chub thob// gsang ba'i dbang bskur chen po ni// gtso bo gsang ba bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor brtsams te/ bdag bskyed rgyas btab kyi bar te/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang dbyer med pa bcom ldan 'das ma hā mā ya sku mdog sngon po sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis na ka pā la dang mda'/ g.yon pa gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang gzhu 'dzin pa/

rtsa ba'i phyag gis rang 'dra ba'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la 'khyud pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing thal chen gyis byugs pa/ thod skam gyi cod pan dang mgo rlon gyi do shal/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi'i pags pa bgos te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar can 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ mig gnyis su a/ rna ba gnyis su khe/ sna gnyis su tsi/ snying gar ra/ thugs ka'i cha stod du nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus bsgoms pa 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i 'od kyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lag pas lo ma bus pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu dang*/ bkra shis kyi glu'i mngon par dbang bskur bas rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan par gyur/ de ltar cho ga rdzogs pas/ slob ma la/ dam tshig cho gar gang gsungs pa// yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro// gang gi lus kun brtan byed pa// de ni phyag rgyar rab tu grags// zhes slob ma la smras nas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi mgo bor oṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ lter bar swā/ gsang gnas su āḥ brla gnyis la hā rnams rigs lnga'i rang bzhin/ yum gyi mkha' hrīḥdamar po las pad+ma dmar po/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i ge sar ser po/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ sngon po las rdo rje sngon po/ oṃ las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po/ phyag rgya dang lhan cig 'dod pa lnga spyad nas/ phyag rgyas/ kye ma gnyen mchog rdo rje 'od kyis pad+ma kha phye zhig /a la la la hoḥ bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor pad+ma kha rab 'byed pa zhig /bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /ces pa'i glus bdag la bskul bas snyoms par zhugs de'i sgras kyang nam mkha' khyab par gnas pa'i gdan gsum gyi lha tshogs chen po yang dag par bskul/

spyi bo nas zhugs byang chub sems su zhu ba phyung nas dkar dmar 'dres pa/ shes rab kyi mkhar gnas pa lce steng du bab par bsam/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// ces mtheb srin gyis khar byin/ a ho su kha zhes pas 'thung*/ khams gsum thabs dang shes rab tu gcig pa'i bde ba chen po myong bar bsam mo// de nas rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu sngon bzhin tshogs dkyil brtsams nas bsgrubs pa der slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ rang bzhin slob dpon go 'phang che// skal pa chen po bdag la stsol// bde gshegs rnams kyi dbang bskur ni// sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub pa// de ni sems can dpag med don// brtul zhugs mchog ni khyod drin gyis// ji ltar 'dul bzhin bdag bgyid do// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis slob ma sgyu ma chen por bskyed pa ste/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma hā mā ya sku mdog sngon po sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis na ka pā la dang mda'/ g.yon pa gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing thal chen gyis byugs pa/ thod skam gyi cod pan dang mgo rlon gyi do shal/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi'i pags pa bgos te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar can 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ mig gnyis su a/ rna ba gnyis su khe/ sna gnyis su tsi/ snying gar ra/ thugs ka'i cha stod du nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus bsgoms pa 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i 'od kyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lag pas lo ma bus pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu dang*/

bkra shis kyi glu'i mngon par dbang bskur bas rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces dbang bskur rgyas gdab kyi bar byas/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas rig ma mdzes sgeg lang tsho dang ldan pa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i ngo bo can spros nas gtad par mos la/ mdzes pa 'di ni gzung ba dang*// bsten par bde gshegs kun gyis brtag /'di ni gzungs ma yid dga' ba// khyod kyis rtag tu bsten par bya// de skad smras nas/ phyag rgya de nyid sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ gcer bu zhabs g.yon brkyang gis yab la 'khyud pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar swā/ gsang gnas su āḥ brla gnyis su hā rnams rigs lnga'i rang bzhin/ yum gyi mkha' hrīḥdamar po las pad+ma dmar po/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i ge sar ser po/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ sngon po las rdo rje sngon po/ oṃ las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po/

ces gnyis ka'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba cha bcu drug pa sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad pa'i mchog dang ldan par rgyas btab pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// de nas/ rnam pa thams cad nub pa rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bla ma dam pa'i drin gyis snying la sad pa chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du sbyor ba gcig pa dbang bzhi pa'o// de nas mig sman dang bcas pa'i gser thur sbyin/ oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// de nas me long bstan la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// bzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de nas/ hoḥlas mda' gzhu phyogs bzhi steng 'og tu 'phangs pas bdud bzhi'i snying phug pas de dag las rgyal bar gyur/ de nas/ hūm̐ zhes pas 'khor lo byin/ deng nas bzung ste 'jig rten la// skyob pa rnams kyis 'khor lo bskor// chos kyi 'khor lo bla med pas// kun tu sdig med dri med pa'o// de nas dung byin te/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su// chos kyi dung ni bla med pas// dri med kun tu gang bar byos// dgang blugs gtad/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar byed dang gnod sogs dang*// bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad de// las de rnams ni bsgrub par gyis// dang*/ de nas rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas/ 'dod pa lnga la longs spyad la/ slob dpon shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal gyis chos gos kyi mtha' snying gar bzung nas/ g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas/ 'dir ni ngas khyod lung bstan yin// he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs// srid pa kun tu bsgrub pa'i sa// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// he shrī

che ge mo na maḥ badz+ra ta thā ga ta sid+dh+ya sa ma ya shrī a mu ka badz+ra ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ he ru ka mkha' 'gror bcas pa dang bla mas mgrin gcig tu lung bstan par bsam mo// zhes lung bstan/ de nas/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// mthong ba dang ni bcug pa yis// sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas// khyed rnams de ring legs par gnas// slob dpon brnyas par mi bya zhing*// gus pa yis ni mchod par bya// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yongs su btang bar mi bya'o// dam tshig sdom pa bsrung bya ste// rnam par mi rtog gos med pas// rang lha'i rnal 'byor gnas pa yis// 'dod pa'i yon tan bsten par bya// khyod rang sangs rgyas kun rigs skyes// dbugs dbyung ngo*// de nas slob mas yon phul/ slob ma rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i mgo bor gdugs phub/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// sogs 'don cing dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor ba byas/ shar phyogs nas phyag byas te tshogs la rol/ 'das ma 'das kyi gtor ma gtong ba dang*/ chos skyong spyi dang bye brag lha mo dud sol ma'i gtor chog bya/ lhag ma gtong zhing smon lam gdab bo/ de nas rjes kyi bya ba la/ mchod pa gsar du bshams pa'am/ kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pūṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta 'i bar dang*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍā ki ni oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bdud rtsi 'bul/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs byed pa// sogs dang*/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ sgrub mchod sogs kyi nyin phyi mar tshig bcad dang bcas pas mchod bstod rgyas par bya/

de nas lhag chad skong ba'i phyir dril bu 'khrol bzhin yig brgya lan gsum bzla/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs nongs bshags dang bzod gsol bya/ sems can thams cad sdig med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sangs rgyas nyid 'phrad 'gyur pa yi// lam de nyid du 'gro bar shog/ ces smon lam gdab/ sgrub mchod skabs ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs bya/ rdul tshon na nyin tha mar/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can sogs dang*/ lha rnams badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs su gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ a kā ro 'i sngags bzla zhing rdo rjes byang shar ram shar sgo nas dbus su re khā drangs la/ rdul tshon mtha' nas dbus su bsdus te cung zad spyi bor bkod/ dri bzang gi chus thig shul dbyi'o/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od zer gyi rang bzhin du byas te bdag nyid la thim/ yum yab la thim/ yab kyi zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim ste/ rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ mig gnyis su āḥ rna ba gnyis su khe/ sna gnyis su tsi/ snying gar ra rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ma hā mā ya sogs/ bdag gis rnal 'byor bsgom pa yi// bsod nams 'di yis 'gro ba kun// sgyu 'phrul chen mo khyab bdag gi /gtso bo'i bdag nyid thob par shog/ ces bsngo ba bya'o// tho rangs rdul tshon bum par bsdus te chu bo chen por dor/ sa der dris byug zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o// de ltar rdo rje 'chang mar rngog gi ring lugs las 'ongs pa'i ma hā mā yā'i cho ga ku ku ri pa'i gzhung bzhin du bshad pa sgyu ma chen po snang ba zhes bya ba/ pad+ma dkar pos rgyal byed tshal du sbyar ba phyogs dus thams cad du rdo rje theg pa la 'gro ba rnams skal pa dge bar gyur cig rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes mkha' 'gro

/ku ku ri pa dang chos kyi pa zhi bzang*/ nā ro mai tri gsum gyis mar pa la/ des rngog chos rdor/ mdo sde/ kun dga'/ gzi brjid/ rin bzang*/ chos rgyal ba/ don grub dpal/ byang chub dpal/ rgyal dbang rje/ a ba dhū tī pa/ chos kyi grags pa/ tshe bdag des bdag go /slad nas dbang bskur dang sgrub mchod sogs la 'jug pa bde bar bklag chog tu bkod pa po ngag dbang mthu stobs tshul khrims bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos/ mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon dpal mgon bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' lung spyi bor mchod nas khungs ldan gyi yig cha rnams dang sgo bstun te bris pa 'dir ma rig nongs gyur mtha' dag snying nas 'chags shing dge bas 'gro kun khyab bdag he ru ka'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// //
